verdict: Organic presence is growing; paid lead generation remains fully paused.
narrative: No paid ads ran on Meta or Google this period, so your Google Business Profile was the sole source of tracked activity. Despite that, GBP engagement rose +55.56% week-over-week — 50 total actions from 341 impressions across 25 of the last 28 days, which points to a healthy and growing local search presence. Website sessions also climbed +45.96% week-over-week to 170 visits, though no intake conversions are being captured in analytics yet — that tracking is being repaired so future sessions report accurately. When paid campaigns resume, they will have a stronger organic floor to build on than the period before.

highlights.phrase: total Google Business Profile actions this period — calls, direction requests, and site clicks
week-over-week lift in Google Business Profile engagement
website sessions this period, up nearly 46% from the prior week

watch_item.issue: Website sessions are growing but zero intake conversions are being recorded in analytics, meaning inquiries from site visitors are going uncounted.
watch_item.fix: Conversion tracking is being repaired so that contact form submissions and intake actions are captured starting next period.
